## Design

### 2026-10-06 — Entry 1: Setting up KiCad and making the schematic for the esp, buttons, and oled.

**2.5h**

Entry 1: Setting up KiCad and making the schematic for the esp, buttons, and oled.
October 5-6

Part 1: Setting up KiCad
- Downloaded KiCad
- Downloaded the libraries required for this project and uploaded them to KiCad. This part took a good 20 minutes since most of the tutorials on YT were 4-5 years old.

Part 2: Esp, buttons, and oled's schematic
- Opened the schematic editor
- Added the ESP32 C3:
1. Added: GND, +5V, +3.3V wires to the ESP
2. Created net labels and attached them to points 2-6: DH11 DATA, GPIO2, GPIO3, SCL, and SDA.

![Screenshot 2026-10-05 225054](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/jwS8qyx2TZPDWDV1nL4t5xmH6j5Vadj4/d42018f547d5968dca77e63ef03c3b91fbef401e3ae63ca7196aa038bcb92075.png)

- Added 2 SW_Push Buttons:
1. Added a GND wire to each
2. Added a net labels: GPIO2 and GPIO3 to each Push button. These net labels are also on lines 3-4 on the ESP

![Screenshot 2026-10-06 162720](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/jwS8qyx2TZPDWDV1nL4t5xmH6j5Vadj4/9d8723934cf1de1b201a1fc9c68a76124343369045077e9b19b4cf7379806288.png)

- I learned that New Labels are used to tell the schematic to connect multiple things without using wires to connect them.

- Added the J1 Conn_01x04_Pin basically the OLED screen:
1. Rotated it and flipped it vertically to match how it looks in the tutorial.
2. Added a GND and +3.3V wire to line 1 and 2.
3. Added net labels: SCL and SDA to line 3 and 4. These net labels are also on line 5-6 on the ESP.

![Screenshot 2026-10-06 163634](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/jwS8qyx2TZPDWDV1nL4t5xmH6j5Vadj4/1b2d02a653ec6391ec9b179dd54fdd633bda507672b0904ff6ff0ff8139e7f3b.png)

Part 3: Organizing
I created rectangular boxes around each of the 3 parts and added a text box at the top right to keep them organized separately.

![Screenshot 2026-10-06 163647](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/jwS8qyx2TZPDWDV1nL4t5xmH6j5Vadj4/a36642cb86d415bcfe05be1e0d259170b648acf015756ee6c28cabd9230a198e.webp)

Thoughts:
Well, now that I look back to how much I actually did I think I could've done this in like 30 minutes but, I think it took me 2 and a half hours since I've never used a software like KiCad and figuring out how to do everything took longer than it should've.
